summary: Reuse trusted integrator Nix fetcher metadata across isolated candidate bootstrap HOMEs instead of downloading locked GitHub inputs for every build

replay.detail: No replay or tree-cache semantics change.

rules.detail: Candidate confinement and Nix evaluation policy are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Pinned sandbox tools and megarepo bootstrap builds use XDG_CACHE_HOME at nix-bootstrap-cache under FRACTAL_INTEGRATOR_SANDBOX_STATE_ROOT, created with mode 0700. Bootstrap HOME remains temporary and credential-free; the cache is not mounted into candidate sandboxes.

manual.detail: The integrator creates the cache automatically; an initially cold cache still needs GitHub access.

recovery.detail: Reverting leaves disposable fetcher metadata under the sandbox state root.
